Class InjectableBag

java.lang.Object
com.github.jjbcoding.trellis.service.InjectableBag
public class InjectableBag extends Object
An InjectableBag stores a series of pre-constructed Injectables. This can be used to courier information from one configuration of the Node tree to another, as it changes.
